newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH FINMIN PLACES FUND AGB IF 2 UNDER ADMIN - CTK.
newsitem.headline: CZECH FINMIN PLACES FUND AGB IF 2 UNDER ADMIN - CTK.

text.p: The Czech Finance Ministry has placed the investment fund AGB IF 2 under forced administration, the news agency CTK reported on Tuesday.
It did not give any further details on the Finance Ministry move, and ministry officials were not immediately available for comment.
Marie Jezkova of the ministry later said the move was made to allow time to investigate circumstances on the fund's moves to change into a holding company. She did not elaborate.

Many Czech funds have made similar moves over the past six months. By turning into a holding copmany, funds are not as strictly regulated and have fewer barriers on the size of holdings they may have in companies.
AGB IF 2 is a major shareholder of troubled Czech bank Agrobanka a.s., with a 20 percent stake.
In the summer, Agrobanka was placed under temporary forced adiminstration by the central bank after experiencing liquidity problems. The bank is still under the forced administration plan.
